what: Emberpup, a young ember wyrm, alone and abandoned: a small lean dragon whelp on four legs, painted as a real reptile, half-grown but never a baby, with no wings at all, a slim neck and a narrow wedge-shaped dragon's head with a long snout, two small black horns sweeping straight back from the top of its head, gold eyes half shut, and a long thin tail. Its scales are bright scarlet-red, the red of red sealing wax, wet and glistening with rain, on its back, head, legs and tail; its belly, throat and the underside of its neck are charcoal-black plates. Along its spine runs one row of small black spines, and between them a row of small coals burned down to a dull dark orange glow, nearly out. It is cold, soaked, lonely and sad.
colours: bright scarlet-red wet scales, the red of red sealing wax, charcoal-black belly and throat plates, small black horns and black spines, a row of dull dark orange coals along the spine, black claws, gold eyes, a boulder of dark warm grey stone with brown in it, a small dark charcoal-grey rain cloud, streaks of rain in bright silver-white.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it crouches low on top of the rock, all four legs folded under its body, the two front feet side by side at the front edge of the rock; its back is hunched against the rain and its head hangs down below the level of its shoulders, its chin almost touching the stone, its eyes half shut and looking down; its thin tail hangs limp down the side of the rock. It is the picture of loneliness, like a dog left out in the rain. Exactly four legs and no more: two front legs and two hind legs, all four shown once each.
scene_whole: shown whole and small in the middle of the picture: the rain cloud above, the little dragon in the middle, the rock below. The little dragon is the biggest thing in the picture. A wide band of empty flat green backdrop runs all the way round the scene: above the cloud, below the rock and at both sides; nothing touches the edges of the picture
scene_action: It is a still, quiet, sad moment like a frozen frame: nothing moves but the rain. The little dragon is hunched and drooping; it is not fighting, not walking, not roaring.
scene_props: The little dragon lies on one single low flat-topped rock of dark warm grey stone with brown in it, wet and shining, a little longer than the dragon's body and no taller than its legs are long; the rock stands by itself on nothing, with no ground, no grass and no puddle round it. Close above the dragon's back, no higher than one head's length above it, hangs one small dark charcoal-grey rain cloud, no wider than the dragon's body, a soft lumpy cloud nearly black underneath with pale grey lit tops. Bold slanting streaks of bright silver-white rain fall from the cloud onto the dragon's back. There is no sky: the whole background is the flat green. Nothing else is in the picture.
must_show: the same lean scarlet dragon whelp as the Emberpup: black horns, black belly, black spines, no wings
lying hunched on top of one grey boulder, chin down on the stone, eyes half shut: plainly sad
one small dark rain cloud directly above it
bold silver-white rain streaks falling from the cloud onto it, readable at 64 px
a real young reptile painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: flame on the tip of the tail
